dedupe_keys.name: powermodelsgmdlib power network test cases for geomagnetically induced current studies

description: PowerModelsGMDLib is a library of power network test cases prepared for geomagnetically induced current (GIC) studies with the PowerModelsGMD.jl package, holding cases too large for that package's unit tests. It is maintained by Arthur Barnes and Jose Tabarez of Los Alamos National Laboratory, and a Zenodo snapshot was published in June 2026, tested with PowerModelsGMD.jl v1.0.0. It includes versions of the RTS-GMLC test network with the data needed for GIC calculation, translated to the Pacific Northwest, the eastern United States and the northern United States, and cases derived from the Texas A&M synthetic grids by Adam Birchfield, plus the Horton 20-bus GIC benchmark and a modified IEEE 118-bus case. Derived data include PSS/E RAW exports, JSON files adding equivalent DC networks, extended MATPOWER cases and GIS information. Coverage is synthetic grids placed in the United States. The data are accessible on GitHub and as a zipped archive of about 85 MB on Zenodo at no cost. Caveats: no licence is stated, and the README lists open to-do items such as missing files for some cases. Simulation uses are GIC and geomagnetic disturbance vulnerability studies and mitigation planning. Related records: model-powermodelsgmd-jl is the solver, and data-rts-gmlc and data-tamu-electric-grid-test-cases are the source grids.
